Summary Files Reviews Support Code Svn Tickets ▾ Bugs Feature Requests News Discussion Donate Menu ▾ ▴ Create Ticket View Stats Group v1.0_(example) Searches Changes Closed Tickets Open Tickets Help Formatting Help #107 Incorrect date parsed when week and month used together Status: closed Owner: Stephen Colebourne Labels: Joda-Time (76) Priority: 5 Updated: 2014-02-06 Created: 2011-01-19 Creator: Aman MANOCHA Private: No I have following code snippet : DateTimeFormatter dtf = DateTimeFormat.forPattern("xxxxMM'w'ww"); DateTime dt = dtf.parseDateTime("201101w01"); System.out.println(dt); It should print 2011-01-03 but it is printing 2010-01-04. Please let me know if I am doing something wrong here. Discussion Stephen Colebourne - 2011-01-20 Not sue what you think you are parsing/printing here. The parse is taking the year, month and week-of-weekyear (see ISO8601 week based dates). Since you haven't specified a day, I think Joda-Time will choose Monday. If you would like to refer to this comment somewhere else in this project, copy and paste the following link: Aman MANOCHA - 2011-01-20 But it is giving year as 2010 instead of 2011. Is it correct? If you would like to refer to this comment somewhere else in this project, copy and paste the following link: Stephen Colebourne - 2011-02-15 This certainly isn't ideal as the parsing isn't giving you very much that is sensible. However, I've had a look at the parsing and its nigh on impossible to change it to give the right answer. The problem is the mixture of weekyear based and month based, which the code simply can't handle without a significant rewrite. So, I've checked in an improvement that handles this case, but not every case. Better, but not fixed.
